title: Wayfarer's Star
description: Add a wearable “Wander Beacon” to Minecraft, used for saving waypoints, teleporting between locations, and enabling player-to-player teleportation on servers, while also helping players search for, locate, and teleport to all structures within a modpack.
body:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xuNAZRkz/images/3e089a15d607e7d94cc3c18929f51e985910e853_350.webp)

1.Wayfarer's Star
Wayfarer's Star is a teleportation and exploration utility mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge. It adds a wearable beacon item that lets players save waypoints, teleport across dimensions, manage discovered dimensions, and search for registered structures in a modpack.
The mod keeps part of the exploration progression: players must unlock a dimension before locating or teleporting to structures inside it. Structure names will use in-game translations when available, and fall back to registry names when no translation exists.
2.Features
- Save, edit, and delete personal waypoints.
- Teleport to saved waypoints across dimensions.
- Search and locate modpack structures.
- Display approximate structure coordinates.
- Supports structure teleportation and random travel.
- Supports teleport requests between players.
- Configurable XP level costs for structure teleportation.
3.Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge
**- Requires Curios API**

1.远游信标 / Wayfarer's Star
远游信标是一个适用于 Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge 的传送与探索辅助模组。它添加了一个可穿戴的信标物品，玩家可以用它保存点位、跨维度传送、管理已探索维度，并搜索整合包中注册的结构。
模组保留了一定探索感：玩家需要先解锁对应维度，才能在该维度使用探测与传送功能。结构名称会尽量显示游戏内已有的本地化名称，没有翻译时则显示原始名称。

2.主要功能
- 保存、编辑、删除个人点位。
- 跨维度传送到已保存点位。
- 搜索并探测整合包中的结构。
- 显示结构的大致坐标。
- 支持结构传送和随机远行。
- 支持玩家之间发送传送请求。
- 可配置结构传送的经验等级消耗。
3.依赖
- Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge
- 需要 Curios API
